title: Hi, I'm Kika
personalIntro: I'm Kika: a software developer, lifelong gamer, and cat mom to Wanda and Jett. I like turning curious ideas into things people can use, explore, and play.
professionalSummary: I'm early in my software development career, with experience building client-specific features for manufacturing software. I've worked across Java and Spring Boot back ends, Angular and TypeScript front ends, APIs, databases, testing, and production troubleshooting.
